1142b34: Now understanding too, and good understanding, in respect of which we call
1143a1: people of understanding and of good understanding, are neither wholly the same as knowledge
1143a2: or opinion (for then all would have understanding), nor any one of the
1143a4: particular sciences, such as medicine, which is about matters of health, or geometry, which is about magnitudes; for it is neither about things that are always and
1143a5: unchanging, that understanding is concerned, nor about any and every one of the things that come to be,
1143a6: but about those which one might be in perplexity about and might deliberate over. Hence about
1143a9: what one ought to do or not, the end of it is; but understanding
1143a10: is only judging. For understanding and good understanding, and people of understanding
1143a11: and of good understanding, are the same. And it is neither the having of practical wisdom
1143a14: to use opinion so as to judge about those things with which
1143a15: practical wisdom is concerned, when another speaks, and to judge rightly; for
1143a16: rightly and well are the same. And from this has come the name, understanding,
